api.notes: Rendered before the message in the default variant only, as upstream (the divider variant does not render it). Size: the budget is the measured gzip size + about 10%; it includes the ICU message parser (about 33 kB) that every translating family bundles (see provisional-budgets.json), which the performance work package removes.

api.reason: A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(base|content|icon|divider) or the tokens.

differences.text: In the divider variant the separator is named by the message text through aria-label on the divider, and the visible content is forwarded to the divider's label slot, so rich content (a <time>, bold text) keeps its markup. The host keeps upstream's `status` role.
All the text is one flex item beside the icon, so inline runs (text and <strong>) are not separated by the icon gap as they would be if each were a flex item.

core.chat-system-message.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-web-components] (role and name through ElementInternals; the separator's name is text, not an IDREF across roots).
